issuing_body: AI Strategy Headquarters (人工知能戦略本部)
covered_actors: AI Strategy Expert Panel (人工知能戦略専門調査会)
Cabinet Office Secretariat of Science, Technology and Innovation Policy (内閣府科学技術・イノベーション推進事務局)
Relevant ministries and agencies (関係省庁)

evidence.quote:
人工知能関連
技術の研究開発及び活用の推進に係る専門的な事項の調査のため、専門調査会
を設置する。
evidence.quote_en: An Expert Panel shall be established to investigate specialized matters related to the promotion of research, development, and utilization of AI-related technologies.

implementation_notes: Organizational decision by Japan's AI Strategy Headquarters establishing the AI Strategy Expert Panel pursuant to Article 1 of Cabinet Order No. 281 of 2025 to investigate specialized matters under the Act on the Promotion of Research, Development, and Utilization of AI-Related Technology (Act No. 53 of 2025), including guidelines (Article 13), surveys and research (Article 16), and the Basic Plan (Article 18). Members are appointed by the Prime Minister, working groups may be formed as needed, and secretariat affairs are managed by the Cabinet Office in cooperation with relevant ministries.
